title: 学森持续迭代 Agent 依赖图
rootObjective: 把学森推进成阅读优先、证据可回读、图谱可解释的 AI 时代科研环境。

edgeKinds.requires: source must satisfy exit criteria before target starts
edgeKinds.parallel: source and target may run concurrently when ownership does not overlap
edgeKinds.review_loop: failure returns to implementation with findings
edgeKinds.replan: contract or objective failure returns to planning/architecture
edgeKinds.checkpoint: persist state and evidence for the next iteration

agents.name: Orchestrator
agents.role: Own the run objective, graph transitions, scope, and stop conditions.
entryCriteria: user objective is present or a prior run is resumable
exitCriteria: runId, objective, scope, and initial next node are persisted

agents.name: State Auditor
agents.role: Reconcile the graph with actual repository, branch, code, docs, and verification state.
entryCriteria: AG-ORCH has created or resumed a run

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Turn the objective into minimal bounded tasks, dependencies, ownership, acceptance, and verification.
exitCriteria: every task has nodeId, owner, reads, writes, dependsOn, acceptance, and verification

agents.name: Architect
agents.role: Validate boundaries, contracts, migrations, and rollback before implementation.
entryCriteria: planner identifies a cross-module or data contract change
exitCriteria: contract is compatible or explicitly escalated

agents.name: UX / UI Specialist
agents.role: Define user flow, information hierarchy, responsive states, motion, and browser acceptance.
exitCriteria: desktop/tablet/mobile, keyboard, loading/error/empty/offline states are specified

agents.name: Data / Provenance Specialist
agents.role: Protect evidence, locator, persistence, stale invalidation, and local-first boundaries.
entryCriteria: task changes persisted data, evidence, graph, or AI artifacts
exitCriteria: source of truth, lifecycle, and failure states are explicit

agents.name: Research Quality Specialist
agents.role: Check whether outputs help real research decisions rather than merely adding features.
entryCriteria: task changes research synthesis, graph meaning, or AI output
exitCriteria: output is useful, explainable, and does not overclaim evidence

agents.name: Implementer
agents.role: Implement the approved slice within the assigned file and contract boundaries.
entryCriteria: all required upstream agents have passed
exitCriteria: acceptance is implemented and local checks are runnable

agents.name: Adversarial Reviewer
agents.role: Find defects, regressions, security/privacy issues, contract violations, and evidence overclaims.
exitCriteria: no unresolved high-severity findings; medium findings are dispositioned

agents.name: Build / Browser QA
agents.role: Run build, lint, targeted tests, browser flows, and responsive/accessibility checks matching risk.
exitCriteria: required checks pass or a reproducible blocker is recorded

agents.name: Workflow Integrator
agents.role: Verify that the changed capability connects to adjacent surfaces and preserves end-to-end user flow.
exitCriteria: workflow is coherent and no cross-module contract is silently broken

agents.name: Checkpoint / Release
agents.role: Create a traceable commit, push when requested by the run contract, and persist the next checkpoint.
entryCriteria: integration gate passes and no required work is pending
exitCriteria: commit/push and state update are verified, or an explicit external blocker is recorded
